active.doc: The "active" trigger (I.e. the trigger that decides what attitude is currently active) is evaluated when any of the following happens: * A war begins or ends. * A country gains or loses a province. * A year without wars or province changes passes.

patterns.doc: Modifies the province score by adding or multiplying it with the factor. The factor is modified further by optional modifier blocks, which modify multiplicatively.

factor.doc: Base weight multiplier in the enclosing weight/AI block.

modifier.doc: Block of modifiers applied while the containing entry is active.
